cover_headline: Morgan Stanley Beats Estimates as Bank of America Misses on $1.2 Billion Settlement Charge
facts: Morgan Stanley earnings of $3.03 per share beat the $2.83 expected, with revenue of $20.34 billion against $19.74 billion expected
A $1.2 billion anti-money-laundering settlement cut Bank of America's reported earnings to $0.91 per share
Bank of America returned $8.3 billion in dividends and buybacks, while Morgan Stanley repurchased $1.5 billion of stock

quote.text: Morgan Stanley reported another strong quarter with net revenues of $20.3 billion, EPS of $3.03 and a ROTCE of 22.6%.
quote.speaker: Ted Pick

end.headline: Morgan Stanley Beats Estimates as Bank of America Misses on $1.2 Billion Settlement Charge
end.line: Morgan Stanley rode a 41% jump in equity trading and record wealth revenue to a clean beat, while a one-time compliance settlement pushed Bank of America below estimates.
